stem: Vikram's scores are $11$, $12$, $13$, $14$, and $45$. He wants a typical value for the main cluster.

parts.text: Which claim correctly chooses the better typical value?

options.text: The mean is better even when $45$ pulls the mean far from $11$, $12$, $13$, and $14$.
The median $13$ represents the main cluster better, because $45$ pulls the mean away from that cluster.
Choosing the median is what creates the outlier score $45$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The outlier $45$ shifts the mean to $19$, while the median $13$ stays with the main cluster $11$–$14$.

teacher.key_rationale: Scores $11$–$14$ cluster together; $45$ is an outlier that pulls the mean to $19$. The median $13$ stays with the main body of values.
